label: scam
text:
Your vehicle has an unpaid toll bill. To avoid excessive late fees on your bill, please settle it promptly.
Thank you for your cooperation!
Total amount: $6.99
Payment:
[…]
(Please reply Y, then exit the SMS and open it again to activate the link, or copy the link to your Safari browser and open it)
notes: Toll smishing (iMessage). Payment link blurred on the page. Transcribed by hand from a screenshot published on the page and cross-checked against Windows OCR. Line breaks follow the screenshot where they separate fields; wrapped lines are joined. […] marks text hidden on the page itself (FAKE stamp, blur or an overlay); nothing was filled in. Hard case: no named agency, no strong-rule wording.
